user.selfNotice: This is your own account, so suspending and deleting are turned off here.
user.suspendBody: They're signed out everywhere and can't sign in or use the app. Their events stay viewable for guests but read-only: no uploads, no downloads.
user.unsuspendBody: They can sign in again and their events work as their packages allow.
user.deleteBody: Deletes the account, every event it owns and all their files. Payment records lose their link to the account. This can't be undone.
user.paymentsHint: Payments are per event: see each event below for its package and payments.

events.title: Every
events.searchPlaceholder: Title, link code or owner email

event.lockedNotice: Guest uploads were closed by an admin on {date}. The event is read-only until it's reopened.
event.ownerSuspended: The owner's account is suspended, so this event is read-only.
event.lockBody: Overrides the package: nobody can upload, and the hosts can't change settings or dates. Viewing, the live wall and downloads follow the package.
event.unlockBody: The event follows its package again.
event.archiveBody: Guests can no longer open it (guest page, live wall, share links). The hosts still see it. Files are kept.
event.deleteBody: Deletes the event and every file in it. This can't be undone.
event.typeSlug: Type the link code {slug} to confirm
event.fairUseNotice: This event passed the fair-use limit ({gb} GB) on {date}. Uploads keep working; admins were emailed once.
event.markPaidBody: Gives the event a complimentary package without a payment. It goes live on its gallery dates and is kept for the usual retention period.
event.resetSetupBody: The event goes back to setup: guests can't join until it's paid for. Only for events marked as paid by an admin.
event.clearFairUseBody: Removes the flag. If the event is still over the limit, the next upload flags it again and admins get another email.

media.deleteBody: The files are deleted from storage. This can't be undone.

moderation.title: Needs a
moderation.lead: Photos and videos guests reported, and shots the automatic check held back, across every event. Newest first.
moderation.empty: All clear. Nothing waiting for review.
moderation.blockBody: Everything they uploaded to this event is hidden, and their device can't upload or join again. You can unblock them later.

system.title: System
system.integrationsLead: Only whether each setting is present. Secret values are never shown here.

cronLead.expiry: Daily: “gallery ended, download everything” emails, and reminders 30 and 7 days before files are deleted.
cronLead.cleanup: Daily: deletes files of events past their retention date, abandoned uploads, old login codes and expired share links.
cronLead.media: Retries guest previews, watermarks and video transcodes that are still pending or failed 10+ minutes after upload (3 tries each). Daily on Hobby, every 10 minutes on Pro.

runBody.expiry: Runs the same job as the daily schedule. It is safe to repeat: each event gets each email once. Emails may be sent.
runBody.cleanup: Runs the same job as the daily schedule. Files of events past their deletion date are deleted for good.
runBody.media: Processes up to 60 waiting photos and videos now (about 4 minutes at most). Safe to repeat.

system.runDone: Done. The run is listed below.
system.blobWarningTitle: Storage is Vercel Blob: originals are not private
system.blobWarningBody: Blob files are public behind unguessable links, so "originals only after payment" is not guaranteed and signed links can't expire. Set up the private Cloudflare R2 bucket (R2_* settings) before going live.

settings.title: Product
settings.lead: Prices and limits used across the site, the app and Stripe Checkout. Changes apply straight away; events that are already paid keep their dates and deletion date. Every change is written to the audit log.
settings.saved: Saved. The new values apply now.
settings.invalid: One or more values are outside the allowed range.
settings.reasonHint: Saved to the audit log with the old and new values.

eventPricePence.label: Event package price
eventPricePence.hint: What a host pays once per event (VAT included). Used on the pricing page and in Stripe Checkout.

guestDownloadPence.label: Guest “download everything” price
guestDownloadPence.hint: What a guest pays for every photo and video of an event (later stage).

windowDays.label: Longest gallery window
windowDays.hint: How long a gallery can be live, from opening to closing.

fairUseGb.label: Fair-use storage per event
fairUseGb.hint: Past this, uploads keep working but the event is flagged and admins are emailed once.

videoMaxSeconds.label: Longest video
videoMaxSeconds.hint: Checked in the browser before uploading and again on the server.

retentionMonths.label: Retention after the gallery ends
retentionMonths.hint: Files are deleted this long after closing. Applies to events paid or re-dated after the change.

hostTestUploadLimit.label: Test uploads before paying
hostTestUploadLimit.hint: How many photos or videos hosts can add in test mode.

email.subject: Fair use: {title} passed {limit} GB
email.heading: An event passed the fair-use limit
email.body: {title} (owner {owner}) now stores {gb} GB, over the {limit} GB fair-use limit.
email.body2: Uploads keep working. Have a look and decide whether to get in touch with the host.
email.footer: Internal alert for admins (ADMIN_EMAILS). Sent once per event.
